messages.plaintextBody:
Hello Ryan:
Defend sustainable healthcare at ASIA HEALTH FORUM 2026 - June 5 (Friday, 8:30am) at the Manila Marriott. Presented by iCare, with Elite Partners Bioessence, Fullerton Health, mWell, Sante. Register at www.asia-ceo.org/Event/260

Stop reacting to illness. Start preventing it. Protect your employees, secure your health coverage, and keep your reputation as a company that truly cares.

Presenters & Panelists:
Dr. Edgar Eufemio - Orthopedics, Cardinal Santos Medical Center
Joseph Feliciano - Chief Executive Officer, Bioessence
Carmie de Leon - Country General Manager, Fullerton Health
Annaliza Laxsamana - Chief Executive Officer, NaHeal
USec Kim Lokin - President & CEO, Philippine Pharma Procurement Inc. (PPPI)
Dr. Mark Malanay - Chief Operating Officer, iCare
Dr. Loysa Orense – President, Vireo Loadworks
Flo Pacia - Head of B2B, mWell
Gideon Pena - Chief Commercial Officer, iCare
Guia Santos - Marketing Head, SANTE

ASIA HEALTH FORUM 2026, presented by iCare
When: Friday, June 5 | 08:30am – 11:30am
Where: Manila Marriott
Investment: Php3k (includes gourmet healthy food)
Elite Partners: Bioessence, Fullerton Health, mWell, Sante
REGISTER at www.asia-ceo.org/Event/260
DOWNLOAD Event Program HERE

Lifestyle diseases are killing our people and harming our businesses. Discover the cutting edge of vitality at Asia Health Forum 2026 — and learn how extending "Healthspan" slashes lifetime care costs.

For questions, call me, the Maid-to-Made CEO, at 09088804177 anytime. See you there, Ryan.

All the best,
Rebecca Bustamante, CEO
Asia CEO Events
